home.description:
Home for TV replaces the cluttered, ad-filled home screen on Android TV and Google TV with a clean one inspired by the Apple TV and iOS lock screen.

• A tall liquid-glass clock over 4K wallpapers, with the scenery standing in front of the time
• One row of up to 8 apps you choose; everything else is one press below
• Profiles: each person gets their own apps and wallpapers
• Now Playing mini player and a Control Center: volume, brightness, sleep timer, Night Shift, Screen off, Do Not Disturb
• Weather card, plus StandBy clock faces that double as the screensaver, including Now Playing with time-synced lyrics

Setup happens on the TV, no computer needed. A short welcome lets you add people and pick their apps. If you switch on debugging, the app sets itself up as your Home button. On tested TV models it can also turn off the preinstalled ad and tracking apps; they’re only switched off, never removed.

Open source. No ads, no tracking.
